title: Magnetic Monopoles
description: Grand unified theories say magnetic charges must exist, made in the first instant, and Dirac showed that one would explain why every electric charge is a whole number of e. The Pulsed Magnet Lab can search for them in magnetar crust.

puzzle.goal: If a single magnetic charge g exists anywhere, the reduced quantum of action ħ and the elementary charge q fix its smallest value. Write g.
puzzle.name: Dirac quantisation
puzzle.ask: Find g in units of 10⁻¹⁵ Wb (u = @{u}) with h = 6.626e-34 J·s and q = 1.602e-19 C.
puzzle.method: An electron carried round the monopole must come back with the same phase: q·g/ħ must be a whole multiple of 2π.
